material_input_classification.input: synthetic probability eligibility, binning, exact scores, coverage, missingness, subgroup, temporal, abstention, and mutation mechanics
real calibration tolerance, subgroup policy, minimum cell size, decision thresholds, and deployment authority
real point-in-time probability predictions, mature labels, subgroup attributes, and abstention observations
calibration, coverage, stability, fairness, predictive utility, and operational performance
sealed calibration attacks and external hidden evaluation

hard_boundaries: Ranking scores are not probabilities unless a registered probability contract proves their range and semantics.
Null labels, missing values, sparse cells, and abstentions remain explicit and are never coerced to negatives.
Stage-2/3 and post-decision information cannot affect Stage-1 calibration inputs or ranking.
Synthetic intervals and sensitivity ranges are not empirical confidence intervals.
Subgroup and temporal outputs expose exact denominators and do not establish fairness or stability.
Live ranking, production calibration, and external writes remain disabled.
